main_text.head: DE LEGATIONE EVANGELICA AD INDOS CAPESSENDA.
PROOEMIVM.
main_text.p: Quum admonitio illa Apostoli, quâ ad Ephesios utitur, si unquam alias,Eph.s.15. hoc certè tempore necessaria sit, ut videamus quomodo circumspectè am-bulemus, non ut insipientes sed ut sapien-tes; redimentes occasionem, quia dies ma-li sunt: non alienum ab officio meo fore putavi, si his Apostoli vestigijs insisterem, & pro mensura gratiæ, in me à Domino collatæ, conservos ad observationem & usum moniti Apostolici excitarem: quod ut facerem provocavit me nova vitæ secundum Deum feliciter instituendæ oc-casio, nobis à Domino oblata, postquam nauticis[?] expeditionibus, aditus ad eas or-

page.notes: The first letter of "nauticis" is partly obscured by a mark on the scan; read as "nauticis" with [?]. The marginal reference is printed "Eph.s.15." (Ephesians 5:15), with the long s shown as a plain s. The faint text at the top of the page and the ghost text in the body are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. No running head is printed on this page, as it opens the division.
